MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The mouse and USB hard drive fit the practical computer accessories I have bought to support my setup, although neither meets an immediate need for me.",
    "The wired earbuds connect reasonably to my previous headset purchase because they serve a similar listening purpose, but I would consider them only if I needed a replacement."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The smart speaker and streaming devices do not help with the computer connections and accessories I have been buying.",
    "My tablet mount does not establish that I need a new tablet or own an iPad Mini that fits the recommended case.",
    "A Wi-Fi extender solves a coverage problem I have not indicated, and an HDMI cable is useful only if my equipment needs that connection; my previous cable was DVI."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat buying electronics accessories as interest in widely used electronics of almost any kind.",
    "They seem to assume that buying an accessory means I also want the associated device or more accessories, even when ownership and compatibility are unclear."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent purchase addressed wired Ethernet connectivity, which makes a specific connection need more relevant than a general interest in wireless products.",
    "My purchases are spread over years and serve distinct practical purposes. A related item is not enough to make me act unless I have a current problem to solve.",
    "Exact connectors and supported device models matter to me; a similar purpose does not make two accessories interchangeable."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my interest in practical computer accessories but stretch it into broader electronics interests without enough evidence of a current need or compatible equipment."
}
